reconstructed_theorem_text: For every natural number n, including zero, and every element Q of the full real orthogonal group O(n), let rho := Measure.haarMeasure(top : PositiveCompacts(O(n))), normalized to give the entire group mass one. The pushforward of rho by left multiplication O -> Q * O equals rho. Equivalently, for each Borel set E in O(n), rho({O in O(n) : Q * O is in E}) = rho(E). O(n) = {A in R^(n x n) : A^T A = I} has its inherited finite real matrix topology and Borel sigma-algebra, and no determinant-one restriction is imposed.
objects: The full orthogonal group O(n), an arbitrary group element Q, the actual constructed measure rho = Measure.haarMeasure(top : PositiveCompacts(O(n))), and the left-multiplication map O -> Q * O.
domains: n ranges over all natural numbers, including zero, and Q ranges over every real orthogonal Fin n by Fin n matrix. O(n) has the inherited finite real matrix topology and Borel sigma-algebra. O(0) is a singleton. The group is not restricted by determinant one.
quantifiers: For every n and every Q in O(n), locally define rho as the displayed constructor and assert rho.map (fun O => Q * O) = rho. O is the bound argument of the multiplication map. The Borel-set formulation quantifies over all Borel subsets E of O(n).
assumptions: No hypotheses on Q beyond membership in O(n), and no positive-dimension premise. Compactness, nonemptiness, Hausdorffness and second countability of the group are internally supplied; the constructor is normalized at the whole group.
conclusion: Equality of the pushforward measure under left multiplication by each fixed Q and rho itself, as Borel measures on O(n).
scopes: rho is defined inside each pair of quantifiers n and Q, but its defining expression depends on n alone. The assertion concerns left multiplication by a fixed arbitrary group element. It does not separately state a right-multiplication law, uniqueness of Haar probability, or invariance for a random Q depending on O.
constant_dependencies: The measure rho depends on n and the fixed group topology and Borel structure, with whole-group normalization mass one. It is independent of Q; the pushforward map depends on Q. No additional free constants occur.
